author_partial: C-infinity regularity of standard parameter-ray interiors for every exponentially bounded address, in the potential coordinate, with nonzero derivative.
credited_foundations: Foerster-Schleicher dynamic-ray construction, parameter-ray existence and simple roots, and nonzero dynamic potential derivative.
remaining_gap: Geometric real analyticity of general parameter-hair interiors; no general analyticity proof or parameter counterexample obtained.
excluded_conclusions: classification of every parameter whose Julia set is the plane
transfer of fixed-map dynamic non-analyticity to parameter rays
